snippet.title: DevLog#2: Spring - Cosy Game in Unreal Engine 5 (Level Design & New Animals)
snippet.description:
In this devlog, I began working on level design in Unreal Engine 5, focusing on separating map regions using spline-based landscapes. This helped shape the world and guide exploration in a more natural way.

What’s new in this episode:
- Region separation using landscape splines
- Two new animals added: Frog and Spider
- New trees, grass, and flowers
- A pond area with foliage and lily pads
- A new bridge puzzle where you must find missing planks to fix it

The world is slowly becoming more alive and interactive, with more places to explore and simple puzzles to solve.

If you’d like to see a tutorial on how I built any of these systems or assets, let me know in the comments!

#Devlog #UnrealEngine5 #IndieGame #GameDev #UE5 #LevelDesign
